question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**distant**" is appropriate in the context as it refers to parts of the world that are far apart. (दूरस्थ)
 
• The passage discusses trade and cultural links, which often span large geographical areas.
 
• The other options: "**indifferent**," "**indirect**," and "**further**" do not convey the sense of geographical separation needed in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The silk routes are a good example of vibrant pre-modern trade and cultural links between distant__ parts of the world.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Indifferent (उदासीन)**: means having no particular interest or sympathy.
 
• **Indirect (अप्रत्यक्ष)**: means not directly caused by or resulting from something.
 
• **Further (आगे)**: means at a greater distance or more advanced point.
